title: ISO 19115-2 to STAC Mapping Extension
description: Defines the mapping from ISO 19115-2 metadata to STAC and adds iso:* fields for ISO concepts that have no equivalent in any existing STAC extension.

oneOf.$comment: Schema for STAC Collections. Each location is validated via allOf (not anyOf): a Collection carrying assets/item_assets/summaries could otherwise satisfy an anyOf branch without its top-level iso:* fields ever being validated, leaving the field typing cosmetic. All iso:* fields are optional, so applying the field schema unconditionally at top-level rejects nothing legitimate.

allOf.$comment: Fields in Collection assets (validated when present).
Fields in item_assets definitions (validated when present).

Typed summaries: when an iso:* field appears in summaries its value must be an array of the same type as the scalar field. Uses the same $defs as the field definitions to avoid duplication. Other summaries keys are unconstrained.

CI_PresentationFormCode.$comment: ISO 19115-1 CI_PresentationFormCode codelist. Includes the digital, hardcopy, audio, multimedia, physical-object and diagram members.

MD_CharacterSetCode.$comment: ISO 19115 MD_CharacterSetCode codelist. Note: the canonical member for US-ASCII is `usAscii` (not `ascii`).

fields.$comment: All iso:* fields are optional at the schema level. Required-ness is set by the profile (see README), not by the schema.

iso:data_creation_date.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_DataIdentification.citation.CI_Date.date [creation]. Event used for reference date (creation). RFC 3339 date-time (e.g. 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z); aligns with STAC `datetime`. Pad partial dates: `2014` -> `2014-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Omit the field when the date is unknown (do not send the string "null").

iso:data_revision_date.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_DataIdentification.citation.CI_Date.date [revision]. Event used for reference date (revision). RFC 3339 date-time; same shape and migration as iso:data_creation_date.

iso:data_publication_date.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_DataIdentification.citation.CI_Date.date [publication]. Event used for reference date (publication). RFC 3339 date-time; same shape and migration as iso:data_creation_date.

iso:lineage_statement.$comment: DEPRECATED in v0.3.0. Prefer `processing:lineage` from the STAC Processing extension (https://github.com/stac-extensions/processing), which explicitly cites NASA's ISO lineage information as its source. Retained for one release as a fallback for FAO producers that need a strictly Collection-top-level field with an iso: prefix; scheduled for removal in a future release.
iso:lineage_statement.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_DataIdentification.resourceLineage.LI_Lineage.statement. A human-readable statement describing the data's lineage. DEPRECATED: new producers SHOULD use `processing:lineage` from the STAC Processing extension instead.

iso:purpose.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_DataIdentification.purpose. Free-text summary of the intended purpose of the resource.

iso:use_constraints.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_LegalConstraints.useConstraints. MD_RestrictionCode codelist value, same enumeration as iso:access_constraints.

iso:use_limitation.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_LegalConstraints.useLimitation. Free-text limitation on use applying to the resource.

iso:other_constraints.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_LegalConstraints.otherConstraints. Free-text other constraints applying to the resource.

iso:supplemental_information.description: ISO 19115-1 MD_DataIdentification.supplementalInformation. Free-text supplemental information about the resource that does not fit elsewhere. Source spreadsheet recommended appending to STAC `description`; carrying it as a typed iso:* field preserves the ISO/STAC round-trip.
